challenges_in_brief: W3-010, medium, reword device_notes: the row presents the blessed_aram hit at web:Dan.6.10 = oshb:Dan.6.11 as a blessing signal, but the device inventory labels that hit as the kneeling homograph. Second medium finding on the same row: the strongest rival is misstated. The real rival is that verse as the close of the preceding unit, since both SAMEKH marks are followed by a verse opening with the same assembling verb. The seam does not move; the rival should be named as live.

W3-014, medium, confidence moves to medium: high is argued from the close alone. The onset edge is the one the preceding row grades medium, with no mark and no formula on the notice side. It is the only high among the book's 75 rows.
W3-008, low, reword strongest_rejected_alternative: the one-verse rival is rejected partly because no mark follows web:Dan.5.31 = oshb:Dan.6.1. The silence is true but is not counter-evidence.
